messages:
lena (People Ops): Quick heads up — we've published a small amendment to the Employee Handbook under 'Remote Work & Reasonable Accommodations'. Please read and acknowledge by EOD Mar 28. Link: https://redwood-internal/docs/handbook/remote-amendment-2026 (short summary below)

lena (People Ops): Summary: 1) clarified eligibility for hybrid vs fully remote for US & EU hires; 2) new process for manager-submitted workplace accommodation requests; 3) updated time-to-respond SLAs for accessibility requests (72 hours initial response).

maria (People Ops): Action items for managers: 1) confirm acknowledgement in the tracker CSV, 2) ensure direct reports have been notified, 3) escalate any outstanding accommodation needs to people-ops@redwood. We'll run audits next week.

sam (Manager): Acked — will push to my team at our 10am standup. Do managers need to upload receipts or docs for accommodation approvals?

lena (People Ops): Not yet. If an accommodation requires financial support, we'll ask for manager approval + receipts via the internal form. Normal guidance: document the request in the tracker and attach a ticket ID.

raj (Eng): Quick Q — how does this affect contractors/consultants? Some of ours are long-term and WFH full time.

maria (People Ops): Contractors: policy clarifies that vendor contractors are covered for accessibility protections but not for hybrid eligibility benefits (e.g., home office stipend). We included a short FAQ in the doc.

devon (Recruiting): Heads up — update the candidate offer checklist. We should include a line about remote eligibility flags so hiring knows what benefits to include. I'll update the checklist and ping hiring team.

sam (Manager): Is there a compliance training or quiz tied to this, or just an acknowledgement?

lena (People Ops): For now: manager acknowledgement + team notification. There's an optional micro-training (5–7min) that covers accommodation workflows and manager responsibilities — strongly recommended. We will make it required for people managers next quarter.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled — people-managers cohort A (teams A–M) assigned handbook-ack task, due 2026-03-28 23:59 UTC. Link to tracker: https://redwood-internal/hr/ack-tracker.csv

maria (People Ops): Manager message template you can copy to your team:

```
Hi team — we've updated our Remote Work & Accommodation policy. Please take 5 mins to read the short summary: https://redwood-internal/docs/handbook/remote-amendment-2026. If you need an accommodation, please submit it here: https://redwood-internal/hr/accommodation-form.
If you have questions, ping me or @lena.
```

sam (Manager): copying that into my standup notes now :thumbsup:

raj (Eng): Will managers get a weekly digest of outstanding acknowledgements?

maria (People Ops): Yes — compliance-bot will post a summary on Friday mornings with outstanding counts per manager. We'll also follow up directly for >7-day delinquencies.

compliance-bot: [AUTOMATED] Training/ack assigned -> 154 managers, cohort A assigned, 78 outstanding as of 2026-03-24T09:12Z

devon (Recruiting): Thanks — I'll coordinate the offer checklist change and add a brief note in the hiring docs.

lena (People Ops): Thanks everyone. If you have edge cases (global-location-specific issues, visa constraints, etc.) DM me or drop them here and we'll triage.

sam (Manager): Will do. One more ask: can people-ops send a short slide for all-hands? Keeps folks consistent.

maria (People Ops): Yep — putting together a 2-slide deck now, will drop in #announcements later today.
